follow-up time: From early to late stages of pregnancy, with birth outcomes recorded
cohort: 1,694 pregnant women aged 18 years or older in Sweden
finding: A history of violence, including emotional abuse, is associated with an increased risk of caesarean section and premature birth.
mod_finding: History of violence was associated with an increased risk of both planned and emergency caesarean sections.
gest_age: Infants born at <37 weeks gestation were considered premature
